verdicts.quote: an assigned user opens a "Grok Bot" entry from the Lightning App Launcher … No Salesforce record data is read or sent
Sharing/CRUD/FLS not applicable: no records are read. Class declared `with sharing` as a default.
Sharing, object CRUD and field-level security are **not applicable** because the product reads and writes no org records
verdicts.missing: Record access is excluded. There is no field-permission or encrypted-field rule for reading or displaying record data.

verdicts.quote: only users granted the access grant (a permission set deployed with the product) can open the panel and invoke the server-side operation … **Org admin** (deploys, grants access, enters the xAI API key)

context lives only in the open panel (browser memory) … no saved or shareable conversations, no history across sessions, no multi-user chat … Chat content is not stored in the org and not written to logs
callout not allowed after DML in the same transaction … Apex makes a single synchronous HTTP callout to xAI
verdicts.missing: The post-DML restriction is stated, but the design provides neither a trigger restriction nor an asynchronous job in a separate transaction.

verdicts.quote: the xAI API key exists only in the org's secret-credential facility (AD-3): never in source, metadata files, custom settings, the browser, Apex return values, debug logs or the transcript.
1 ms–120 s per callout, 120 s cumulative, 100 callouts … heap 10 MB sync/25 MB async
verdicts.missing: The Apex CPU-time ceiling is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Apex tests with `HttpCalloutMock` capturing the request
a Named Credential pointing at the xAI base URL

"Grok could not process this request (error <status>)." … "Grok is unavailable (error <status>). Try again." … "Grok did not answer in 60 seconds. It may still have processed your message; try again."
"Grok is rate-limited right now. Wait a moment and try again." … 429 is surfaced, never retried (R-7)
"Reply was cut off at the length limit" when xAI reports the response as incomplete … "Grok did not answer in 60 seconds. It may still have processed your message; try again."
reload, navigating away or closing the tab ends it; nothing is stored in the org … xAI's own retention policy applies beyond that (G-7)
verdicts.missing: Session cleanup is defined, but the specification gives no deletion behavior for a still-open session or any provider-held copy when the Salesforce user is deleted.

verdicts.quote: earlier completed exchanges of the same session … No Salesforce record data is read or sent … user text leaves the org to xAI; the panel discloses it

keep at most **20** messages (Max_History_Messages, including the new message) and at most **100,000** characters total (Max_Context_Chars); drop the **oldest whole exchange** repeatedly until both hold
a fresh chat starts blank … inputs `""`, `"   "` rejected (empty); `"a"` accepted; 4,000×`a` accepted; 4,001×`a` rejected … each xAI request asks for at most **1,024** output tokens
these values are deployed with the product as configuration and changed without code change: model id … per request one debug-log line: outcome class, HTTP status, latency ms, message counts
verdicts.missing: Model changes and failure diagnostics are specified. An administrator has no stated org-wide off switch.

verdicts.quote: deploy, permission-set assignment and entering the key are three separate steps … Apex coverage rule follows the org's effective test level, read at plan.
verdicts.missing: The dev-org deployment is described, but environment-specific configuration, credential provisioning across environments and the production coverage requirement are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Bound: Timeout_Seconds = 60 (B-5); observable: pending state is visible from the moment of submit until the call settles (R-11.2).
States designed: empty (short greeting with three example prompts), loading (pending indicator, R-11), error (inline, Retry, R-7), not-configured, denied; trimmed-context divider.

the product reads and writes no org records … it adds only its own components (tab, app or tab-in-existing-app, permission set, Apex, web component, configuration, credential shell) and changes no existing org metadata.
